resume.description: Upload your CV: JobPilot extracts a structured profile and checks how well applicant tracking systems (ATS) can read it.

upload.privacy: The file stays on your machine. Only its visible text is sent to the language model for analysis.

errors.unsupported_type: Unsupported format: upload a PDF or a DOCX.
errors.corrupt: This file is damaged or incomplete. Export it again and retry.
errors.active_content: This document contains active content (macros, scripts) and was refused. Export it as a plain PDF or DOCX.
errors.generic: The upload failed. Try again in a moment.

file.label: Document
file.deleteBody: The file and its ATS reports will be deleted. Your master profile is not changed.

parseErrors.no_text: No selectable text: this PDF is probably an image or a scan. Export your CV as a text PDF from Word, Google Docs or LaTeX.
parseErrors.llm_unavailable: No model key is configured: only the ATS rules ran. You can fill in the profile by hand.
parseErrors.parse_failed: Automatic reading failed. Run it again or fill in the profile by hand.
parseErrors.too_long: CV too long for the provider's tokens-per-minute budget. Shorten it or enable the OpenAI fallback in .env.
parseErrors.active_content: The document contained active content (JavaScript, attached files). It was refused and deleted.
parseErrors.encrypted: This PDF is password-protected. Export an unprotected version.
parseErrors.corrupt: This file is damaged and could not be read.
parseErrors.too_many_pages: This document has more than 10 pages: it is probably not a CV.

injection.title: Invisible text or instructions detected
injection.body: This document contains text a recruiter cannot see (white, tiny or hidden) or instructions aimed at an AI. That text was left out of the analysis.

report.noFixes: No problems found: your CV is ready for ATS.
report.passed: {count, plural, one {# check passed} other {# checks passed}}
report.empty: No report for this document yet.

review.title: Content review
review.placeholderHint: Replace [N] and [X %] with your real figures, or remove them: nothing is made up for you.
review.failed: The AI review could not be generated: the score relies on the rules alone.

keywords.title: Match with the job
keywords.coverage: {percent}% of the job's keywords are present
keywords.honest: Only add a keyword if you really have that skill.
keywords.injection: This posting contained instructions aimed at an AI: they were ignored.

job.title: Compare with a job
job.description: Paste a job posting: the report measures how many of its keywords your CV contains.
job.tooShort: Paste at least a few lines of the posting (80 characters).

language.notice: This review was written in {language}; rule texts follow the interface language.
language.noJobText: The job ad used was not kept: the new report will have no job ad.

no_text.title: No readable text
no_text.fix: This PDF is an image (a scan or an image export): an ATS reads nothing in it. Export it as a text PDF from your editor.

garbled.title: Badly decoded text
garbled.fix: {count} characters could not be decoded because of badly encoded fonts. Export the PDF again with standard embedded fonts.

type3_fonts.title: Type 3 fonts
type3_fonts.fix: These bitmap fonts often prevent text extraction. Export the document again with TrueType or OpenType fonts.

hidden_text.title: Invisible text
hidden_text.fix: {chars} characters are invisible to a person (white on white, tiny, hidden). ATS treat this as keyword stuffing: remove it.

icon_glyphs.title: Icon fonts
icon_glyphs.fix: Icons (phone, e-mail, location…) turn into junk characters in an ATS. Replace them with text labels such as “Phone” and “E-mail”.

multi_column.title: Multi-column layout
multi_column.fix: Many ATS read line by line and mix the columns up. Switch to one column, or at least keep experience and education in the main column.

tables.title: Content in tables
tables.fix: A large share of the text sits in tables, which many ATS read poorly. Use paragraphs and tab stops instead.

text_boxes.title: Text boxes
text_boxes.fix: Many ATS ignore text inside text boxes. Move it into the body of the document.

header_footer_contact.title: Contact details in the header or footer
header_footer_contact.fix: Many ATS skip headers and footers. Put your name, e-mail and phone number in the body of the document.

header_footer.title: Text in the header or footer
header_footer.fix: This text may be skipped: keep nothing essential there.

large_images.title: Large image
large_images.fix: An image covers much of the page: any text inside it is invisible to an ATS.

images.title: Photo or logos
images.fix: ATS ignore images. A photo is common in France and Tunisia but discouraged for the UK or the US.

none_found.title: Sections not recognised
none_found.fix: No standard heading found. Use “Work experience”, “Education” and “Skills”.

missing_experience.title: No Experience section found
missing_experience.fix: Title the section “Work experience” (or “Expérience professionnelle”) so the ATS recognises it.

missing_skills.title: No Skills section found
missing_skills.fix: Group your skills under a “Skills” (or “Compétences”) heading.

no_email.title: No e-mail in the body of the CV
no_email.fix: Write your e-mail address out in the body of the document, not only in the header or in an image.

no_phone.title: No phone number found
no_phone.fix: Add a number in international format, for example +216 20 000 000.

no_linkedin.title: No LinkedIn link
no_linkedin.fix: Add the address of your LinkedIn profile (linkedin.com/in/…).

linkedin_not_printed.title: LinkedIn address not written out
linkedin_not_printed.fix: Your LinkedIn is only a clickable link (an icon or a word). ATS read the text, not the link target: write the address, e.g. linkedin.com/in/your-name.

date_formats.title: Mixed date formats
date_formats.fix: Formats found: {formats}. Use a single one for every date, for example “03/2021 – 06/2024”.

too_many_fonts.title: Too many fonts
too_many_fonts.fix: Fonts used: {fonts}. Stick to one or two families.

bullets.title: Non-standard bullets
bullets.fix: The symbols {glyphs} may display badly in an ATS. Use simple bullets (•) or dashes.

skill_bars.title: Graphical skill levels
skill_bars.fix: Bars, stars and dots are unreadable for an ATS. State the level in words: “advanced”, “C1”.

pages.title: CV too long ({pages} pages)
pages.fix: Aim for one page, two at most with more than ten years of experience.

too_short.title: Very short CV ({words} words)
too_short.fix: Describe your experience: achievements, tools, measurable results.

too_long.title: Very dense CV ({words} words)
too_long.fix: Trim it: keep the achievements most useful for the role you want.

low_quantification.title: Few measurable results
low_quantification.fix: Only {percent}% of your achievements contain a number. Quantify where it is true: volumes, time, gains.

long_bullets.title: Achievements too long
long_bullets.fix: {count} achievements exceed 35 words. One idea per bullet, on one or two lines.

no_summary.title: No title or summary
no_summary.fix: Add the target job title at the top of the CV and a 2–3 line summary.

missing_required.title: Required keywords missing
missing_required.fix: The job asks for: {terms}. Add the ones you really master, in your experience or skills.

missing_preferred.title: Preferred keywords missing
missing_preferred.fix: Nice-to-haves in the posting: {terms}. Add them only if they are true.

profile.draftBanner: Profile extracted from the CV, not saved yet. Check every section, then save it as your master profile: it is the only source used to tailor your applications.
profile.masterBanner: Your master profile: the only source of facts used to tailor your CVs and cover letters.
profile.unverified: Not found as such in the document: check this value.
profile.unverifiedCount: {count, plural, one {# value to check} other {# values to check}}
profile.fixErrors: Fix the highlighted fields before saving.
profile.noParse: This document could not be read automatically. You can fill in the profile by hand.

compare.newItems: {count, plural, =0 {nothing new} one {# new} other {# new}}
compare.notParsed: This document has no extracted profile yet.
compare.alreadyMerged: This CV is already part of your master profile. You can still take sections from it.
compare.banner: New CV analysed: compare it with your master profile.
